stemMarkdown: 40 litres of a 25% acid solution is mixed with 20 litres of a 10% acid solution. What is the acid concentration (in %) of the resulting mixture? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Acid from the first: $10.00$ L. From the second: $2.00$ L. Total acid $= 12.00$ L in $60$ L of mixture, so the concentration is $20.0\%$.
